rapport_notes: Warm, personable tone; good name clarification and genuine listening; customer clearly comfortable and engaged throughout.
process_discipline_notes: Rep asked 'did you have any other questions' twice (once mid-call, once near end), creating minor redundancy; no silence violations on open-ended questions.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Not present — rep launches straight into probing without time-boxing or framing the call length and value exchange.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after logistics probing: 'Okay, and then did you have just any general questions for me that I might be answer for you' — this comes after full logistics details (address, unit numbers, parking, elevator, boxes, furniture inventory) have already been captured.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised concern about price: 'I think they quoted it automatically for four hours and I don't, it was really expensive. So I just wanna make sure because I don't necessarily think I'm moving out of a two bedroom but I'm only moving one bedroom.' Rep acknowledged but pivoted immediately to inventory: 'Okay. So, yes, so it did that because of the square footage. So, generally, a square footage unit, like, this takes us about five to seven hours actually...' — one surface-level acknowledgment, no real second-layer follow-up on the customer's pricing concern.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with_answered_anywhere: Customer mentioned: 'the dresser, it's a nine drawer dresser that's pretty heavy... I think that will be the biggest challenge.' Rep acknowledged: 'Okay, I got you.' Rep later said: 'we will wrap pad and protect every single piece of furniture before we put it onto the truck as well. That standard.' — carefulness/protection covered, though not using the 'most careful with' framing.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming_answered_anywhere: Never addressed — no mention of who the crew will be, Meet Your Mover program, or crew lead assignment.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_covered_anywhere: Never mentioned — no discussion of on-time performance or guarantee.
evidence_quotes.communication_covered_anywhere: Mentioned late: 'if you just give us a shout either way whichever, when it's more convenient' and 'if you do have anything that you need, you need answered or something changes. You can reach out via email or if you just give us a shout' — communication method offered, but no day-before call, named crew lead, or inbox updates mentioned.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Partial — rep states 'generally, a square footage unit, like, this takes us about five to seven hours actually' (range given), but does NOT personalize it to customer's specific move profile (only one bedroom, minimal items, short distance, elevator access both ends). The anchor is generic, not tailored.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_commit_to_rate: Not present — no 100k-moves experience framing or rate commitment language.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_estimate_is_a_window: Yes — 'the time range is really just for us to make sure we have the truck at a good allow of time you know. So we're not rushing'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_beats_it_pay_less: Yes — 'if we get there and you know, everything is pretty much ready to go... if you end up using two and a half. The two and a half hours 2:00 to three then that's all you end up paying for anyway.'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_self_prep_tip: Not present — no mention of pre-packing, pre-disassembly, or items customer can do before crew arrives to reduce billable time.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_does_that_feel_fair_then_s: Not present — rep asked 'did you have any other questions' but never used the 'does that feel fair?' close, and did not hold silence after the question.
evidence_quotes.close_rate_lock: Not present — no mention of rate locking upon booking.
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: Absent — rep said 'thank you so much for answering my call this morning and we look forward to seeing you in a couple of days' — assumes acceptance without an explicit close-the-deal ask.

top_strength: Excellent discovery of logistics details (addresses, elevator windows, parking, inventory, unit numbers) and strong rapport-building through warm tone and genuine listening; customer felt heard and comfortable throughout.
coaching_note: Front-load a quid pro quo framing ('this'll take about 6 minutes and I'll get you an accurate quote'), dig deeper on the customer's stated pricing concern in Stage 1 (don't pivot after one acknowledgment), and close with an explicit ask plus rate-lock language after confirming the estimate feel fair.
